_metadata.description: In-code learning verbs, durable evidence, dependency closure, and flagship scenario adoption.

requirements.title: Ten governed learning verbs
requirements.description: New programs MUST use the ten learn.* verbs for in-code learning instead of introducing a new whole-program learning declaration.

validation.notes: kernel/tests/test_learn.py and the checked-in learn-verbs-example contract exercise the verb surface.

requirements.title: Task and step tree capture
requirements.description: Tasks, named steps, and bounded gather children MUST serialize as one parent-first attempt tree.

validation.notes: kernel/tests/test_learn.py and vrooli-memory/.vrooli/program-runtime/finish-attempt.py cover child registration and tree capture.

requirements.title: Query recall and adopted choice
requirements.description: Recall MUST accept query-shaped input and bounded summaries, while choose MUST record an explicit adoption decision.

validation.notes: kernel/tests/test_learn.py and compare-outcomes.py cover recall, choice, and derived verdict behavior.

requirements.title: Agent provenance
requirements.description: Learning capture MUST preserve explicit agent provenance through preparation, finish, and delivery.

validation.notes: learning.proto and vrooli-memory/api/internal/learning/learning.go carry the provenance fields used by capture.

requirements.title: Fragment executor and cache
requirements.description: learn.act MUST validate normalized fragments, enforce a binding allow-set, and reuse verified durable fragments.

validation.notes: kernel/tests/test_learn.py, api/internal/tasks/store_test.go, and the second all-verb fixture run provide the evidence.

requirements.title: Undeclared dependency finding
requirements.description: Programs validation MUST report programs.dependency_undeclared for learning or binding edges absent from the owning manifest.

validation.notes: api/handlers/programs-validation/module_test.go covers the finding and contract schema declares the learning projection.

requirements.title: Program dependency graph
requirements.description: Scenario Dependency Analyzer MUST expose program-derived binding edges with a marked file fallback.

validation.notes: scenario-dependency-analyzer/api/internal/deployment/program_bindings.go and the P3 DAG artifact provide the validation reference.

requirements.title: Honest memory degradation
requirements.description: Memory and delivery failures MUST produce explicit unavailable, uncertain, or blocked states without rerunning domain work.

validation.notes: Task bridge/store tests and the improve skill setpoint rows cover blocked delivery and degradation reporting.

requirements.title: Flagship learning loops
requirements.description: Browser Automation Studio and Device Control MUST declare and exercise stable learning operation keys for their workflow artifacts.

validation.notes: Both scenario-owned workflow suites pass; a live BAS browser receipt remains unavailable in the current validation window.

requirements.title: Verified repair and compatible reuse
requirements.description: When a learned fragment fails verification, the runtime SHOULD reject that candidate, provide bounded repair evidence to inference, and reuse only compatible independently verified implementations.

validation.notes: Focused regression passes recorded in docs/internal/PROBLEMS.md; full scenario gates retain unrelated failures. Requirement completion awaits owner evidence synchronization.

requirements.title: Portable reviewed baselines
requirements.description: When optional learning services are absent, the runtime SHOULD execute a compatible reviewed baseline from the program contract, verify its postcondition, and retain an explicit learning delivery receipt.

validation.notes: Focused regression passes recorded in docs/internal/PROBLEMS.md; full scenario gates retain unrelated failures. Requirement completion awaits owner evidence synchronization.

requirements.title: Evidence-informed selection
requirements.description: When prior advice is contradicted or avoided, the runtime SHOULD preserve that evidence through recall and select an eligible option or return an explicit no-option result.

validation.notes: Focused regression passes recorded in docs/internal/PROBLEMS.md; full scenario gates retain unrelated failures. Requirement completion awaits owner evidence synchronization.
